gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Autour One is loud and round, drawn like a marker nib. Noto Sans Khmer is the quiet counterweight, with generous openings and small letters standing nearly capital-sized, which makes the difference between them stark.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Fat, unshaded outlines from Autour One rush into every round letter. Noto Sans Khojki moves along smoothly, its wide exits passing light through and every e showing a large open eye.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Reading here feels friendly: rounds stay unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and capitals barely tower over the lowercase. Noto Sans Khudawadi supplies that friendliness, while Autour One draws the heading as a single thick thread.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Autour One is heavy and rounded, with no thin strokes to fade. Noto Sans Lao Looped shapes words as solid blocks rather than skylines, with bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Autour One hits hard and round, its diagonals matching its horizontals and a clear channel leading into each curve. Noto Sans Limbu counters with tall-bodied small letters and gaping curves.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Noto Sans Lydian reads gently, capitals barely taller than lowercase, openings wide as a sprung paper clip. And Autour One brings the heft, every letter drawn with a single constant line width.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall against its capitals, with a wide throat in the e like a funnel. Noto Sans Mahajani then hands the headline over to Autour One, whose line glides under the eye like wire.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen reads openly, with small letters standing proud and curves ending in clear daylight. Autour One handles the shouting, its g drawn in one unchanging line weight, while the body does the quiet talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-modi: Noto Sans Modi lets daylight into every curve, with capitals and lowercase sitting close in height. Noto Sans Modi then gives Autour One's uniform up and side strokes plenty of room to be loud.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro reads dense and tall through the middle of words, with large entrances into each letter's inner space. Autour One, with strokes like bent plastic tubing, loosens it up.
